John Stuart Mill, The Autobiography of John Stuart Mill.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/john-stuart-mill/the-autobiography-of-john-stuart-mill

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- John Stuart Mill, the author and annotator, died 1873 (Wikidata Q50020, P570 = 1873-05-08).

First publication of the text used: 1873 (SE colophon: 'The Autobiography of John Stuart Mill was published in 1873 by John Stuart Mill').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1873, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States. The edition's statement of rights below says the same.
- Other countries: the last person to die among the people whose words are in the text died in 1873 (1925 or earlier), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
